steps.content:
?? ??, N.F. 11?

Outskirts of Furor, Farlands
Bathed in moonlight, the sandstone lies deathly still.

steps.speaker: Injured Merchant
steps.content: Pant... pant... cough cough cough...
The injured merchant staggers forward, dragging his broken body across the barren expanse. Behind him, the caravan's sand ship lies wrecked against the rocks, its hull devoured by roaring flames.

He clutches his side, fingers slick with blood, but it still seeps through—crimson spreading along his clothes, falling in heavy drops. Each step falters; each footprint stains the stone beneath him, leaving a trail of fading life behind.

steps.speaker: Injured Merchant
steps.content: Who the hell attacked us... Desert bandits? But we made sure to avoid the trade route... Dammit...

steps.speaker: Injured Merchant
steps.content: At least... I need to get what Sibilla entrusted to me... to DisCity...
The man groans as he fights to lift his head, only to meet the cold glint of steel in the darkness.

A blade pierces through his shoulder, and pain erupts like fire, searing through his nerves as the force slams him into the sand. His agonized cries tear through the night, followed by footsteps approaching from behind.
Oh, don't run away yet. Our little game was just getting to the good part.
I'll admit, you've got some skill to make it this far... Shame you heard things you shouldn't have, helped when you shouldn't have.
Blood seeps between the merchant's fingers, turning the sand beneath his palm to mud. His vision swims, but through the haze, he catches the glint of a metal insignia on his attacker's clothes.

steps.speaker: Injured Merchant
steps.content: You're... with the Campbells? So all this time... you've been watching Furor? Afraid your dirty secrets would slip out...?
So, you do know what you've walked into, don't you? Good, that just makes things way easier.
Come on, tell me, which one of your little Furor friends put you up to this? Give me a name, and maybe I'll let you walk away.
The merchant collapses to his knees, blood bubbling at his lips, his voice a ragged whisper.

steps.speaker: Injured Merchant
steps.content: Sorry to disappoint... cough cough... you're too late...
Oh?
Gasping, he mutters something unintelligible—just enough to make his pursuer crouch low, ear tilted toward him in curiosity.

steps.speaker: Injured Merchant
steps.content: ...Go to hell, you noble's pet!!
The merchant's surprise attack is futile. His fist barely grazes the assassin's face, only managing to dislodge her mask.
For a moment, half of her features are exposed beneath the skewed disguise.

steps.speaker: Injured Merchant
steps.content: You?! No, this can't be... The <color=#fb9259>hero</color> working for the Campbells...?!
She adjusts the mask, sliding it back into place with practiced ease.

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: Oops, you recognized me? That's bad... They specifically said to keep this face a secret...

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: Well, since you've seen my face, I'm afraid there's only one way this ends. Don't take this personally, I don't love this part of the job either. But my dear "master" has a thing about meddlers... and well, you were just about to go and spoil his grand reveal...
Before he can react, the cold edge of her blade finds his throat, silencing any further resistance.

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: Now I'll have to make sure you never speak of this again.
The woman's knife hangs poised in the air, then freezes. In the sudden stillness, the merchant hears it: the distant growl of engines cutting through the night, punctuated by loud shouts in Disian.
Someone is coming, and they're from DisCity. In moments, they will see this scene of bloodshed.

steps.speaker: Injured Merchant
steps.content: Nnghh...!
The merchant has no strength left to scream, but his fingers twitch toward the silver line of hope. If he could just call for help. If he could just hold on...!
(Red flash + blood sound effect)
But he could never make another sound.

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: Oh dear, we can't have that now, can we? If I let you scream, what would people say about my professionalism?

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: But I'll leave your body in one piece. Wouldn't want to spoil the surprise for those DisCity folks arriving shortly.

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: Honestly, I'm being unusually generous today. After all...

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: It's so much more interesting this way.
